what: Cycles through several title lines — one line resolves in 1s (letters staggered .03s) from blur 10px·16px below·.85 scale, holds for 2.5s, then the letters, in random order and one every 35ms, each puff out three smoke clumps and scatter upward (30~46px) over 1.1s (blur 12px·1.15~1.55x). .7s after the last letter, a 1.5s rest and then the next line — the smoke is WebGL noise shader clumps that swell and drift up over 2~2.8s

options.hold: Time from forming to dispersing (sec), default 2.5
options.gap: Pause after everything has scattered until the next line (s), default 1.5
options.out: Duration of the letter scatter (sec), default 1.1
options.stagger: Letter stagger as they form (sec), default 0.03
options.each: Gap between letters when scattering (s), default 0.035
options.puffs: Smoke puffs per character, default 3 — 0 means scatter only, no smoke
options.[data-fx-part=line]: One line to rotate through at a time (rotates if two or more)
options.--fx-smoke-light: Smoke light surface, default text color 80%
options.--fx-smoke-dark: Smoke shade, default muted text color 70%

use: Your one title hereYour second title here

from.where: index.html .tb-hero__title (original Hero title, three lines — appear opacity 0·blur 10px·y 16·scale .85 → 1s stagger .03 power2.out, after 2500ms each letter at random 35ms intervals emits 3 smoke puffs, opacity 0·blur 12px·y −30−16r·x ±8·scale 1.15+.4r 1.1s power2.in, last letter +700ms, next line after 1500ms. Smoke is a half-resolution WebGL fbm blob, life 2000+800r ms·radius 70+25r·fills up to 20%)

note: The smoke canvas is a single fixed one stuck to the screen, so even when the title moves with scroll, the plume floats up where it was emitted (the original does the same). The smoke shader is our own 5-layer noise, so the pattern differs from the original. With reduced motion, only the first line stays as is.
